events.title: Laravel first public beta
events.summary: Taylor Otwell released Laravel's first beta as a more expressive PHP alternative to CodeIgniter.
events.about: Laravel is a PHP framework for modern web apps — routing, Eloquent ORM, Blade templates, auth scaffolding. Used for SaaS dashboards, e-commerce, REST APIs, and agency client sites. Example stack: Laravel + MySQL + Vue/React front-end, deployed on Forge or similar.

narrative.whyChosen: Laravel became the default mental model for modern PHP web development.
narrative.whyImportant: It brought elegant routing, Eloquent ORM, and Blade templating to mainstream PHP teams.
narrative.problemSolved: PHP frameworks of the era lacked built-in auth, migrations, and developer ergonomics Otwell wanted.
